_note: SI units. Tesla Model 3 (2018) rear drive unit IPM motor + Model 3 RWD vehicle. Every value carries a source tag: [MXP] MotorXP measurement/analysis whitepaper; [EVS] evspecifications.com / public spec sheets; [DER] derived here from [MXP] data (see scripts/derive_tesla_params.py); [ASM] assumption made in this study.

motor._Ld: [DER] solved from MXP peak point (430 Nm, 1000 Arms, 53.5 deg advance, 94.61 Vrms at 192 kW); SATURATED value at peak load
motor._J_rotor: [DER] solid-lamination estimate from MXP rotor OD/ID/stack length (magnet slots ignored)
motor._T_peak: [MXP] simulated peak torque 430 N m (published 420-450 N m); used as torque limit because the constant-L model would otherwise overestimate low-speed peak torque
motor._P_peak: [EVS] 211 kW rear motor, 2019 Model 3 SR RWD (MXP cites 190-211 kW)

inverter._Esw: [ASM] Eon+Eoff per phase-leg commutation at Vref, Iref (order of magnitude for a ~1 kA SiC leg; sensitivity reported)

vehicle._m: [EVS] 2019 Model 3 Standard Range RWD curb weight
vehicle._v_max: [EVS] top speed of 2019 Model 3 SR RWD

iron._note: Stator iron-loss model (src/aifcs/ironloss.py). Tags as above. NO FEA and NO manufacturer datasheet was available: every value tagged [ASM] is an assumption; sensitivity is reported.

geometry._tooth_width: [ASM] parallel-sided tooth width; chosen so that no-load peak tooth B ~1.66 T (target 1.6-1.7 T)
geometry._yoke_height: [ASM] stator back-iron radial height; chosen so that no-load peak yoke B ~1.48 T (target 1.4-1.5 T). Slot depth = (D_out-D_bore)/2 - yoke_height. Tooth tips neglected

winding._turns_per_coil: [MXP] as stated in the task brief
winding._parallel_paths: [MXP] as stated in the task brief
winding._coils_per_phase: [ASM] double-layer, one coil per slot: 54 coils / 3 phases
winding._k_w1: [ASM] fundamental winding factor (q=3 slots/pole/phase, short pitch unknown); typical 0.93-0.96

material._alpha: [ASM] hysteresis exponent. Must be 2.0 for the harmonic (Parseval) hysteresis sum
material._k_h: [ASM] W s/(kg T^2). With k_c, k_e: P(1.5 T, 50 Hz) = 1.7 W/kg and P(1.0 T, 400 Hz) = 13.5 W/kg, typical 0.30 mm NO FeSi class. No datasheet cited; plausible range 0.007-0.015
material._k_c: [DER] classical eddy coefficient pi^2 sigma d^2/(6 rho_steel) with d = 0.30 mm, sigma = 2.0 MS/m (applied to B in T, f in Hz: W/kg per (f B)^2)
material._sigma: [ASM] electrical conductivity of Si steel, S/m (ro = 0.5 uOhm m)
material._mu_r_eff: [ASM] effective incremental relative permeability for lamination skin-effect screening of the PWM harmonics (only harmonics above ~15 kHz are materially screened)
material._build_factor: [ASM] manufacturing/building factor (punching, welding, shrink fit), typical 1.5-2.0, multiplies all stator iron loss
